verses.1: Praise the LORD! Praise God in His holy place. Praise Him in the vault of His might.
verses.2: Praise Him for His mighty acts. Praise Him for His abundant greatness.
verses.3: Praise Him with the blast of a horn. Praise Him with the lyre and the harp.
verses.4: Praise Him with the tambourine and the dance. Praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes.
verses.5: Praise Him with resounding cymbals. Praise Him with thunderous cymbals.
verses.6: Let everything that breathes praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "the vault of His might" reflects the meaning of "בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּֽוֹ" as "in the vault of His might" — a poetic reference to the heavens as God’s domain.
- v. 5: "resounding" and "thunderous" are used to distinguish the two forms of cymbals mentioned in the Hebrew text.
